caption: The drawing consists of a large rectangular grid-like shape centered on a light beige or off-white background. The rectangle is filled with numerous horizontal lines, mostly evenly spaced, with some lines being thicker and more closely spaced than others. The lines create a sense of layered sections or bands within the rectangle, with the thicker bands located towards the top, middle, and bottom of the rectangle. Many of the horizontal lines are drawn with a pencil or fine graphite, resulting in varying shades of gray. The rectangle is bisected vertically by one main line, dividing the drawing into roughly two equal halves. Some of the horizontal bands within the rectangle are composed of even smaller rectangles or short vertical dashes, contributing to a woven or textile-like appearance. The overall composition is geometric and symmetrical, with the lines carefully arranged, and the background outside the rectangle is left mostly blank.
title: Textile
